data.title: Sustained packed-browser load acceptance
data.description: Review frozen runtime telemetry, direct-CDP owned-Chromium harness, trusted dense-mode input, 600-frame health/evidence checks, artifacts, and browser gate documentation.

data.body: INFO: The press assertion relies on the truthy value of `inputMask & bit` (e.g. 32) rather than an explicit `!== 0` comparison. It works correctly, but the sibling web/browser-smoke.cjs uses the explicit `(inputMask & N) !== 0` form (see its lines 272/279). Matching that form here would keep the two harnesses stylistically uniform. Non-blocking.

data.reason: Behavior-preserving telemetry, dropped-frame semantics match docs, direct-CDP harness cleans up on failure, bit mappings consistent with template, frozen diagnostic surface preserved, no speed thresholds. node --check passes; author verified full 604-frame run. One non-blocking INFO note.
